	}
	picture = cosmogfx_AFFAIR_ADVISOR_ANDALUCIAN_SPYMASTER_3_eventPicture
	}
	
	
	goto = advisorprovince
	is_triggered_only = yes

	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = cosmo_subjects_advisor
				}

					}
				}

			}

			trigger = {
				always = no
			}
			country_event = {
				id = qosmo_twoaffairs_events.53373				
				}
			}			
			80 = { #no std
			custom_tooltip = cosmo_no_symptoms_tooltip 
			}			
			}	   
		}		
	}
